question: What are the hashes of the last three blocks of the pinned inclusive window on chain 8453, newest first?

definitions.window: Use the exact quoted fromBlock through toBlock, both inclusive. Do not substitute a moving latest block.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.source: Use JSON-RPC at https://mainnet.base.org for chain 8453; verify eth_chainId. Chain evidence here is read by panel members, not a deployer recipe.
definitions.metric: Read the hash fields of toBlock, toBlock-1 and toBlock-2, only when within the pinned window. Return fewer entries if the window has fewer than 3 blocks.
definitions.ordering: Strictly descending block number. Return block hashes, not parent hashes or transaction hashes.
